description: Search the Wikibooks Cookbook, read a recipe and rescale it to any number of servings.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-wikibooks-cookbook

environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. This project's identifier stays appended, so Wikimedia can always reach a human.
environmentVariables.name: WB_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, floor 500, ceiling 60000.
environmentVariables.name: WB_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds. Default 20000.
environmentVariables.name: WB_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries on a busy or rate-limited gateway. Default 3.
environmentVariables.name: WB_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.
environmentVariables.name: WB_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: WB_LOG_LEVEL
